description: This is a PHP source file for user login functionality in an e-commerce web application. It handles session management, user authentication by verifying email and password against the database, and displays a login form.

methods.name: filter_var()
methods.description: Filters a variable with specified filter, used here for sanitizing email and password inputs.

methods.name: $conn->prepare()
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, used here for secure user lookup.

methods.name: $select_user->execute()
methods.description: Executes the prepared SQL statement with provided email and password.

methods.name: $select_user->fetch()
methods.description: Fetches the resulting row from the executed query.

methods.name: header()
methods.description: Sends a raw HTTP header to redirect users upon successful login.
